scale: held-out R^2: 0 = predicts nothing beyond the training mean, 1 = exact, below 0 = worse than the training mean

sizes.meaning: constant share: squared length of the mean vector over the 2,000 inputs / mean squared length of a vector (0 = nothing shared by every input, 1 = every input gives the same vector)

attention.meaning: spread: entropy of a head's weights over the 26 handles / log 26; 0 = all weight on one handle, 1 = even weight on all 26

first_layer.meaning: shares: variance over the recorded handle rows of that part of a hidden unit's input, over the variance of the unit's whole input, averaged over the 192 units (parts covary, so shares need not add to 1). difference_gain |w_c - w_a| / 2 multiplies (command position - achieved position); sum_gain |w_c + w_a| / 2 multiplies their sum
